english.title: Without leave of a court / authority remove child not yet placed for adoption from local authority accommodation
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without the court's leave or the authority to do so, removed **(..SPECIFY NAME OR IDENTITY OF CHILD..), a child who was not for the time being placed for adoption, from accommodation at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) provided by **(..SPECIFY LOCAL AUTHORITY..), the local authority which had applied for a placement order, the application for which had not been disposed of
english.legislation: Contrary to section 30(2) and (8) of the Adoption and Children Act 2002.

english.notes:
(i) The section is subject to sections 31 to 33 of the Act but those sections do not apply if the child is subject to a care order.
(ii) Sections 30 to 33 apply whether or not the child in question is in England and Wales.
(iii) Sections 30 to 33 do not affect the exercise by any local authority or other person of the power conferred by any enactment, other than section 20(8) of the Children Act 1989 (removal of children from local authority accommodation)
(iv) Sections 30 to 33 do not prevent the removal of a child who is arrested
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant, without the court's leave or the authority to do so, removed **(..SPECIFY NAME OR IDENTITY CHILD..), a child who was not for the time being placed for adoption, from accommodation at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) provided by **(..SPECIFY LOCAL AUTHORITY..), the local authority which had applied for a placement order, the application for which had not been disposed of.

other.penalty:
Summary: Imprisonment for a term not exceeding three months and / or a fine not exceeding level 5 on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
